description: MBR-106: stable config, data, cache, and log roots. The installer rewrites the placeholders below to the resolved per-user tree before persisting supervisor.json. `membrane cli doctor paths` prints the same values at runtime so an operator can diff a live install against this template.

config.purpose: durable settings; lease file; supervisor.json; never thrown away

data.purpose: persistent memory DB; checkpoints; supervisor state; survives update

cache.purpose: regenerable caches (fastembed artifacts, downloaded models); safe to wipe

log.purpose: append-only logs from resident and supervisor; rotates independently of data

receipt.description: tracks every file the runtime writes outside the four stable roots
receipt.uninstallRespects: files outside the four roots are removed only when listed here

placeholders.__USER__: current shell user; installer substitutes $USER or %USERNAME%
placeholders.__HOME__: current user home; installer reads $HOME or %USERPROFILE%
